title: lamottea calva
intro: Lamottea calva, commonly known as Mountain mint or Calva, is a flowering plant in the mint family. The plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory issues, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lamottea calva include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which make it useful in treating coughs, colds, and other respiratory conditions. Bioactive constituents of the plant include menthone, limonene, and beta-pinene, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
